          Temporary pause

          Pausing disables enforcement until the selected timer expires or Firefox restarts.

          Recent blocked activity

          Only the hostname, reason and timestamp are retained; never full URLs or page content.

            Optional remote list updates

            Disabled by default. When enabled, Blockem fetches only the list URLs you enter. Downloads are capped at 2 MB each.

            Firefox container profiles

            Optional profiles apply to requests from the selected Firefox container.

            Password protection

            Optional. Protects adult blocking, strictness, custom lists and whitelist changes. Passwords are never stored; only a random salt and salted SHA-256 hash are kept locally.

            Loading password settings…

            Strict response inspection

            Opt-in, pass-through inspection of main-frame response bytes only. It detects known list-domain strings without modifying or storing page HTML. This is not a substitute for URL blocking.

            Backup and reset

            Export includes settings and custom lists only. It never includes passwords or activity.
